part1_desc: 第 1–21 步：跟站长分清完成时和过去时；练习里掺着挑战题，边学边辨信号词。
part2_desc: 第 22–49 步：独立判断造纸术资料，难题一路跟到课尾压轴：古今双空对比、被动时态、比较级混考。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析（信号词判断）、双空对比、被动语态时态、比较级最高级混考。Unit 6 Ancient stories 主题。

steps.title: 愚公移山
steps.teach_html:
古代故事第三期：愚公移山 (Yu Gong Moves the Mountains)！

move 是“移动”。愚公带着家人移走了大山。人们讲这个故事讲了几千年：People have told this story for thousands of years.

这期有个关键问题：“我住过北京”和“我2020年住在北京”，英文到底有什么不同？

steps.title: 过去时：结束了
steps.teach_html:
一般过去时：过去发生、已经结束的事。

I visited Beijing last year.（去年我参观了北京——事情结束了。）

steps.title: 完成时：还继续
steps.teach_html:
现在完成时：过去开始、一直持续到现在。

I have visited Beijing.（我参观过北京——这是我的经历，和现在有关。）
I have lived here since 2020.（从2020年起我住在这里——现在还住。）

steps.title: 关键对比
steps.teach_html:
看这一对：

I lived in Beijing in 2020.（2020年我住在北京——现在不住那里了。）
I have lived in Beijing since 2020.（从2020年起我住在北京——现在还住。）

一个结束了，一个还继续。这就是最大的区别。

steps.title: 过去时的标志词
steps.teach_html:
看到这些词，用过去时：

yesterday（昨天）；last week（上周）；in 2020（在2020年）；two days ago（两天前）。

它们都表示“过去的某个时间”，事情结束了。

steps.title: 完成时的标志词
steps.teach_html:
看到这些词，用完成时：

since（自从）；for（持续）；ever（曾经）；never（从不）；already（已经）；yet（还）；just（刚刚）。

它们都和“现在”有联系。

steps.title: 愚公的例子
steps.teach_html:
Yu Gong moved the mountains.（愚公移走了山——故事里发生的事，过去时。）

People have told his story for thousands of years.（人们讲他的故事讲了几千年——一直讲到现在，完成时。）

thousand 是“千”。

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
小结：过去时 = 结束了（yesterday, last year, in 2020）；完成时 = 还继续/和现在有关（since, for, ever, never）。

下面站长带着你练。资料卡在上面，做题时对照着看。

steps.title: 先看资料
steps.teach_html:
这是愚公移山的资料卡。做题时对照着看：愚公是位老人，住在大山边，带着家人移走了山，人们讲这个故事讲了几千年。

下面站长带着你练完成时和过去时。
steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 去年
steps.scene: 去年我参观了北京。
steps.stem: I visited Beijing ___ year.
steps.help: “去年”是过去的时间。
steps.explain: I visited Beijing last year.

wrong_feedback.A: since 是完成时标志，这里 last year 用过去时。
wrong_feedback.B: for 是完成时标志，这里用过去时。
wrong_feedback.C: ever 是完成时标志，这里用过去时。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 从2020年
steps.scene: 从2020年起我住在这里。
steps.stem: I have lived here ___ 2020.
steps.help: “从2020年起”还继续，用完成时。
steps.explain: I have lived here since 2020.

wrong_feedback.A: in 2020 是“在2020年”，这里“自从”用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: 2020 是时间点，用 since，不用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: last 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 信号：很久以前
steps.scene: 古代人很久以前修了这堵墙。
steps.stem: Ancient people ___ (build) this wall long ago.
steps.help: 先找信号：long ago 表示事情发生在什么时候、结束没有？
steps.explain: Ancient people built this wall long ago.

common_errors.say: long ago 是明确的过去时间，要用过去时 built，完成时不能和明确过去时间连用。
build 是不规则动词，过去式是 built，不能加 ed。
builds 是现在时三单；long ago 的事要用过去式 built。
build 是原形，过去的事要用 built。

steps.title: 昨天去了
steps.scene: 她昨天去了上海。
steps.stem: She ___ to Shanghai yesterday.
steps.help: yesterday 是过去时标志。
steps.explain: She went to Shanghai yesterday.

wrong_feedback.A: has gone 是完成时，yesterday 用过去时 went。
wrong_feedback.D: go 是原形，过去时用 went。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 认识十年
steps.scene: 他们认识十年了。
steps.stem: They have known him ___ ten years.
steps.help: “十年”是时间段，还继续。
steps.explain: They have known him for ten years.

wrong_feedback.B: 十年是时间段，用 for，不用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: last 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。
wrong_feedback.D: ago 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 子子孙孙接着挖
steps.scene: 愚公下决心后，他的子孙后代一直挖山，挖到了今天。
steps.stem: Yu Gong's family ___ the mountain since he made the decision. (dig)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。
steps.help: 从愚公那时一直挖到现在；主语 Yu Gong's family 看作一个整体（it）。dig 的过去分词要双写 g。
steps.explain: Yu Gong's family has dug the mountain since he made the decision.

common_errors.say: dug 是过去时；这里从过去一直挖到现在，用 has dug。
family 在这里看作一个整体，用 has，不用 have。

steps.title: 昨晚看了
steps.scene: 我们昨晚看了这部电影。
steps.stem: We ___ the film last night.
steps.help: last night 是过去时标志。
steps.explain: We saw the film last night.

wrong_feedback.A: have seen 是完成时，last night 用过去时 saw。
wrong_feedback.C: see 是原形，过去时用 saw。
wrong_feedback.D: seen 是过去分词，不能单独用。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 从2019年
steps.scene: 他从2019年起在这里工作。
steps.stem: He has worked here ___ 2019.
steps.help: 2019 是时间点，还继续。
steps.explain: He has worked here since 2019.

wrong_feedback.A: 2019 是时间点，用 since，不用 for。
wrong_feedback.B: last 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。
wrong_feedback.C: ago 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 挑战 · Has 吗
steps.scene: 问姐姐试过剪纸没有。
steps.stem: ______ your sister ever tried paper cutting?
steps.help: 先数主语：your sister 是一个还是多个？再看 tried 是什么形式。
steps.explain: Has your sister ever tried paper cutting?

wrong_feedback.A: your sister 是第三人称单数，完成时疑问句要用 Has，不用 Have。
wrong_feedback.C: Did 后面要跟动词原形 try，跟不了过去分词 tried；问经历用 Has。
wrong_feedback.D: Does 后面跟原形 try；这里有 tried 和 ever，表示经历，要用 Has。

steps.title: 讲了几千年
steps.scene: 人们讲这个故事几千年了。
steps.stem: People have told this story ___ thousands of years.
steps.help: “几千年”是时间段。
steps.explain: People have told this story for thousands of years.

wrong_feedback.A: 几千年是时间段，用 for，不用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: last 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。
wrong_feedback.D: ago 是过去时标志，这里用完成时。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 去年去了
steps.scene: 她去年去了北京。
steps.stem: She ___ (go) to Beijing last year.
steps.help: last year 是过去时标志。
steps.explain: She went to Beijing last year.

common_errors.say: gone 是过去分词。last year 用过去时 went。
last year 是过去时标志，用 went，不用完成时。
goes 是现在时。last year 是过去的信号，用 went。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 写出过去分词：write
steps.scene: 把 write 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 write 的过去分词。
steps.help: 想一想 write 的三种形式：write、wrote、第三个是？
steps.explain: write → wrote（过去式）→ written（过去分词）。

common_errors.say: wrote 是过去式（yesterday I wrote），过去分词是 written（I have written）。
write 是不规则动词，不能加 ed：wrote / written。
writing 是现在分词，过去分词是 written。
write 是原形，过去分词是 written。

steps.title: 从2019年
steps.scene: 从2019年起我住在这里。
steps.stem: I have lived here ___ 2019.
steps.help: 2019 是时间点，还继续。
steps.explain: I have lived here since 2019.

common_errors.say: 2019 是时间点，用 since。
in 2019 是“在2019年”，这里“自从”用 since。
from 只说起点，不表示持续到现在；“自从某年到现在”用 since。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 上周就看完了
steps.scene: 同桌问你借那本故事书，你说：我上周就看完了，你拿去吧。
steps.stem: I ___ the book last week. (finish)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。
steps.help: 先找时间词：last week 是已经过去的时间点，这种句子里完成时进不来。
steps.explain: I finished the book last week. 有明确的过去时间 last week，用一般过去时，不能用现在完成时。

common_errors.say: last week 是明确的过去时间，和现在完成时冲突；这时老老实实用过去时 finished。

steps.title: move 的中文
steps.scene: 写出 move 的中文。
steps.stem: 写出 move 的中文意思。
steps.help: 愚公 move 大山。
steps.explain: move 的中文是“移动”。

common_errors.say: “建造”是 build。move 是“移动”。
“参观”是 visit。move 是“移动”。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 昨天参观
steps.scene: 他们昨天参观了长城。
steps.stem: They ___ (visit) the wall yesterday.
steps.help: yesterday 是过去时标志。
steps.explain: They visited the wall yesterday.

common_errors.say: yesterday 用过去时 visited，不用完成时。
visit 是原形。yesterday 是过去信号，要用过去式 visited。
visiting 是现在分词，不能单独作谓语；yesterday 用 visited。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 比较级别漏 than
steps.scene: 两个故事比一比哪个更有意思。
steps.stem: This story is ______ than that one.
steps.help: 先找信号：句中有 than，比较的是几个？
steps.explain: This story is more interesting than that one.

wrong_feedback.B: interesting 是原级，没有比较的意思；有 than 就要用比较级 more interesting。
wrong_feedback.C: most interesting 是最高级的一部分，要跟 the 连用、不能跟 than；这里两者比较，用比较级。
wrong_feedback.D: the most interesting 是最高级，跟 than 连用不对；有 than 用比较级 more interesting。

steps.title: 讲了很多年
steps.scene: 我们讲这个故事很多年了。
steps.stem: We have told the story ___ many years.
steps.help: 很多年是时间段。
steps.explain: We have told the story for many years.

common_errors.say: 很多年是时间段，用 for。
from 不能表示“持续了多久”；一段时间用 for。

steps.reading: Yu Gong was an old man. He lived near two big mountains. He moved the mountains with his family. People have told this story for thousands of years.

steps.title: 新任务：独立判断
steps.teach_html:
新任务来了：这次是蔡伦造纸的资料。资料卡在上面。

这次你自己看、自己答。记住判断方法：先找信号词，再选时态——明确的过去时间（long ago、yesterday）用过去时；since、for 表示一直持续到现在，用完成时。
steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 蔡伦造纸
steps.scene: 蔡伦很早以前造出了纸。
steps.stem: Cai Lun ___ paper long ago.
steps.help: 先找信号词：long ago 表示哪个时间？
steps.explain: long ago 是明确的过去时间，事情已经结束，用过去时 made。

wrong_feedback.B: has made 是完成时。long ago 是明确的过去时间，完成时不能和它连用，要用 made。
wrong_feedback.C: makes 是现在时三单，说的是现在常做的事；蔡伦造纸是过去的事，用 made。
wrong_feedback.D: making 是现在分词，不能单独作谓语，这里用过去时 made。

steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 挑战 · 信号：上周日
steps.scene: 问答：上周日看的电影。
steps.stem: — When did you see the film? — I ___ it last Sunday.
steps.help: 先找信号词：last Sunday 告诉你什么？
steps.explain: last Sunday 是明确的过去时间，用过去时 saw；完成时不能跟明确的过去时间连用。

wrong_feedback.A: have seen 是完成时。last Sunday 是明确的过去时间，完成时不能和它连用，要用 saw。
wrong_feedback.B: see 是原形，问的是过去看的电影，要用过去式 saw。
wrong_feedback.C: seen 是过去分词，必须跟 has/have 连用；这里用 saw。

steps.title: 用了两千年
steps.scene: 人们用纸大约两千年了。
steps.stem: People have used paper ___ about two thousand years.
steps.help: 先看空后面：two thousand years 是一段时间还是时间点？
steps.explain: for + 一段时间（two thousand years），表示持续了多久。

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟时间点（如 2020、last year）；two thousand years 是一段时间，要用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: from 只说从哪开始，不能表示持续了多久，这里用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: in 加时间段表示“在……之后”，不表示持续到现在，这里用 for。

steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 挑战 · 从竹简到博物馆
steps.scene: 两个时代放一句里：古人写在竹子上，今天的我们把竹简收进博物馆保存至今。
steps.stem: Long ago, people ___ (write) on bamboo, and we ___ (keep) the bamboo books in museums since then.
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。

cn: 一直保存着（现在完成时）

steps.help: 一句里两个时代：long ago 的动作已经结束；since then 的动作持续到现在。两个空时态不一样。
steps.explain: Long ago, people wrote on bamboo, and we have kept the bamboo books in museums since then.

common_errors.say: long ago 的事已经结束，用过去时 wrote。
有 since then，是保存到现在，要用 have kept。

steps.title: 写在竹子上
steps.scene: 在纸发明之前，人们把字写在竹子上。
steps.stem: Before paper, people ___ (write) on bamboo.
steps.help: 先找信号：before paper 说的是哪个时候的事？
steps.explain: Before paper, people wrote on bamboo.

common_errors.say: written 是过去分词，要跟 has/have 连用；这里讲过去的事，用过去式 wrote。
has written 是完成时；before paper 指过去那个时期，用过去式 wrote。
write 是不规则动词，过去式是 wrote，不能加 ed。
write 是原形；讲过去的事要用 wrote。

steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 挑战 · 信号：since 从句
steps.scene: 爸爸从二十岁起就在这家工厂工作。
steps.stem: My father has worked in this factory ___ he was twenty.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的是一个时间点、一段时间，还是一个句子？
steps.explain: since 后面可以跟一个表示过去时间的句子（he was twenty），表示“自从那时起”。

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for ten years），不能跟一个句子，这里用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: from 只说起点，不能跟句子表示持续到现在，这里用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: at 跟时间点（如 at seven），不能跟句子，这里用 since。

steps.title: 一直用到今天
steps.scene: 从蔡伦那个时候起，我们一直用纸。
steps.stem: We ___ (use) paper since Cai Lun made it.
steps.task: 写两个词（have + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先找信号：since 出现时，句子要用哪个时态？
steps.explain: We have used paper since Cai Lun made it.

common_errors.say: 只写 used 是过去时。since 表示一直持续到现在，要用完成时 have used。
主语是 We（我们），助动词用 have，不用 has。
use 是原形。since 引导的句子要用完成时 have used。
have 后面要跟过去分词 used，不能跟原形 use。

steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 挑战 · 从司马迁到今天
steps.scene: 司马迁在汉朝写成《史记》，这本书一直被人们读到今天。
steps.stem: Sima Qian ___ (write) Shiji long ago, and people ___ (read) it since then.
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。
steps.help: 还是老办法：先给每个空找时间词。long ago 管第一个空，since then 管第二个空。
steps.explain: Sima Qian wrote Shiji long ago, and people have read it since then. read 的过去分词还是 read（拼写不变，读音变）。

common_errors.say: long ago 是明确的过去，完成时不能进，用 wrote。

common_errors.when: 第二个空写了 have readed
common_errors.say: read 是不规则动词，过去分词还是 read，不加 ed。

steps.title: 挑战 · 信号：持续一百多年
steps.scene: 这座老桥已经立了一百多年了。
steps.stem: The old bridge has stood here ___ more than 100 years.
steps.help: 先看空后面：more than 100 years 是时间点还是时间段？
steps.explain: for + 时间段（more than 100 years），表示持续了多久。

common_errors.say: since 后面跟时间点（如 1920 年）；100 years 是一段时间，要用 for。
from 只说从哪开始，不能表示持续了多久，这里用 for。
in 加时间段不表示“持续到现在”，这里用 for。

steps.title: 在竹子上写过吗
steps.scene: 问对方有没有在竹子上写过字。
steps.stem: ___ you ever written on bamboo?
steps.help: 先看主语是 you 还是他/她，再看 written 是什么形式。
steps.explain: 主语 you 用 Have；written 是过去分词，问经历用完成时：Have you ever written...?

wrong_feedback.A: Has 只跟第三人称单数（he/she/it）连用；主语是 you，要用 Have。
wrong_feedback.B: Did 后面要跟动词原形 write，跟不了过去分词 written；问经历用 Have。
wrong_feedback.D: Do 后面同样跟原形，不能跟 written，这里用 Have。

steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 挑战 · 被动也有时态
steps.scene: 长城是两千多年前修建的。
steps.stem: The Great Wall ______ more than 2,000 years ago.
steps.help: 先想：长城是被人修的，还是自己长出来的？再看 ago 是什么信号。
steps.explain: The Great Wall was built more than 2,000 years ago.

wrong_feedback.A: is built 是现在的被动；ago 表示两千多年前，事情在过去，要用 was built。
wrong_feedback.B: has built 是主动语态，长城不会自己建自己；长城是被人修建的，要用被动 was built。
wrong_feedback.D: builds 是主动现在时，也不对：长城是被人修建的，而且是过去的事，用 was built。

steps.title: 挑战 · 钥匙还没找到
steps.scene: 他找钥匙找了一上午，到现在还没找到。
steps.stem: He ___ his key yet. (not find)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 还没找到（现在完成时否定）

steps.help: 句尾有 yet，而且结果连着现在（现在还没钥匙）。主语是 he，否定要怎么拼？
steps.explain: He hasn't found his key yet. 现在完成时的否定：hasn't + 过去分词。

common_errors.say: didn't find 只说过去没找到；这里强调“到现在还没有”，而且有 yet，用 hasn't found。
主语是 he，用 hasn't，不是 haven't。

steps.title: 昨晚读故事
steps.scene: 他昨晚读了那个古老的故事。
steps.stem: He ___ (read) the old story yesterday evening.
steps.help: 先找信号：yesterday evening 是什么时间？
steps.explain: He read the old story yesterday evening.（read 的过去式还是 read，拼写不变。）

common_errors.say: yesterday evening 是明确的过去时间，完成时不能和它连用，用过去式 read。
reads 是现在时三单；昨晚的事要用过去式 read（拼写一样）。
read 是不规则动词，过去式还是 read，不能加 ed。
reading 是现在分词，不能单独作谓语，这里用 read。

steps.reading: Cai Lun was a Chinese man. He made paper long ago. Before that, people wrote on bamboo. People have used paper for about two thousand years. We still use paper every day.

steps.title: 挑战 · 现在的被动
steps.scene: 现在，这家工厂用木头造纸。
steps.stem: Paper ___ (make) from wood in this factory today.
steps.task: 写两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先想：纸是被造出来的，还是自己变成纸的？再看 today 表示什么时态。
steps.explain: Paper is made from wood in this factory today.

common_errors.say: 只写 made 少了 be 动词。被动语态是 be + 过去分词：is made。
makes 是主动“制造”；纸是被造出来的，要用被动 is made。
today 说的是现在的情况，要用 is made；was made 是过去的被动。
be 动词后面要跟过去分词 made，不能跟原形 make。

steps.title: 挑战前：先找信号
steps.teach_html:
最后一关：挑战段。做题先别急着选动词，先找信号词：

看到 yesterday、last year、in 2019、ago 这类明确的过去时间 → 用过去时（完成时不能和明确的过去时间连用）。

看到 since、for、ever，或一件事从过去一直到现在 → 用完成时。

还有几道混了以前学的被动语态和比较级，慢慢来。

steps.title: 挑战 · 古今双空（上）
steps.scene: 同一个发明，两句话。先看第一句讲什么时候。
steps.stem: Bi Sheng ___ (invent) printing in the Song dynasty.
steps.help: 先找信号：in the Song dynasty 是哪个时间？
steps.explain: Bi Sheng invented printing in the Song dynasty.

common_errors.say: in the Song dynasty 是明确的过去时间（宋朝），完成时不能和明确过去时间连用，用过去时 invented。
invents 是现在时三单；宋朝的事要用过去式 invented。
invent 是原形，过去的事要用 invented。

steps.reading: Bi Sheng invented printing in the Song dynasty. People have used printing for about 1,000 years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 古今双空（下）
steps.scene: 还是印刷术，这句讲从那时到现在。
steps.stem: People ___ (use) printing for about 1,000 years.
steps.task: 写两个词（have + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先找信号：for about 1,000 years 表示持续了多久？
steps.explain: People have used printing for about 1,000 years.

common_errors.say: 只写 used 是过去时。for 1,000 years 表示一直用到现在，要用完成时 have used。
主语 People 是复数，助动词用 have，不用 has。
use 是原形；表示持续到现在要用 have used。

steps.reading: Bi Sheng invented printing in the Song dynasty. People have used printing for about 1,000 years.

steps.title: 挑战 · 古今双空（续·上）
steps.scene: 一个人先住村里、后来搬进城里。先看第一句。
steps.stem: He ___ (live) in the village in 2010.
steps.help: 先找信号：in 2010 是什么时间？他现在还住村里吗？
steps.explain: He lived in the village in 2010.

common_errors.say: in 2010 是明确的过去时间，而且他现在不住村里了，用过去时 lived。
lives 是现在时；in 2010 的事要用过去式 lived。
live 是原形，过去的事要用 lived。

steps.reading: He lived in the village in 2010. He has lived in the city since 2015.

steps.title: 挑战 · 古今双空（续·下）
steps.scene: 同一个人，第二句讲 2015 年到现在。
steps.stem: He ___ (live) in the city since 2015.
steps.task: 写两个词（has + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先找信号：since 2015 出现时，动词用哪种时态？主语是 He，助动词用哪个？
steps.explain: He has lived in the city since 2015.

common_errors.say: 只写 lived 是过去时。since 2015 表示一直住到现在，要用完成时 has lived。
主语是 He（第三人称单数），助动词用 has，不用 have。
lives 是现在时，不能和 since 2015 连用表示持续到现在，要用 has lived。

steps.reading: He lived in the village in 2010. He has lived in the city since 2015.

steps.title: 挑战 · 最高级
steps.scene: 这座山是这一带最高的。
steps.stem: Of all the mountains here, this one is ______ (high).
steps.help: 先数一数：Of all the mountains 是在几个里面比？最高级前面别忘了一个小词。
steps.explain: Of all the mountains here, this one is the highest.

common_errors.say: 最高级前面要有 the：the highest，只写 highest 不完整。
higher 是比较级，跟 than 连用；Of all... 是在许多个里比“最”，要用最高级 the highest。
high 是短词，最高级直接加 est：highest，不用 most。
the higher 还是比较级；许多个里比第一要用 the highest。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
愚公移山和指南针的故事讲完了。过去时和完成时，你分得清了！

下一期是写作课：我的家乡故事——用 since 和 for，写一写你自己的故事。

title: 古今对比：完成时 vs 过去时
